title: Assess Chatticus wiki reuse against the shared Help contract
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

Read-only evidence is already captured on this epic from private Chattic.us-web main 0f92209. Future design deliverable: an explicit reuse/extract/retain/migrate matrix for publication/build.py, catalog.py, chrome.py, heading anchors, theme, catalog metadata, related links, canonical/OG routes, draft exclusions and existing tests. Preserve existing wiki URLs/content provenance and separate public ideas/product docs from private Kanbus notes. Compare current remote source with PPY-7417c5/PPY-917578 landed-slice evidence; verify actual served state only when separately authorized. Do not repeat migration already done or reinstate obsolete local React wiki wrappers. Check product-source ownership and link mappings before changing authoring. No code movement or migration in this planning task.
